revision.text: '''Physics''' is a branch of [[science]] that studies [[matter]], [[energy]], and their interactions. Key areas include [[quantum mechanics]] and [[general relativity]].
'''Quantum mechanics''' is a fundamental theory in [[physics]] describing nature at the [[atom]]ic scale. Related to [[mathematics]] and [[energy]].
'''General relativity''' is a theory of gravitation by [[Albert Einstein]], part of [[physics]]. Describes [[gravity]] and [[spacetime]].
'''Energy''' is a property in [[physics]]. Types include [[kinetic energy]] and potential energy. Related to [[matter]] and [[chemistry]].
'''Matter''' is any substance with mass. Studied in [[physics]] and [[chemistry]]. Made of [[atom]]s.
An '''atom''' is the smallest unit of [[matter]]. Studied in [[quantum mechanics]] and [[chemistry]]. Contains [[electron]]s.
The '''electron''' is a subatomic particle. Studied in [[quantum mechanics]] and [[physics]]. Part of the [[atom]].
'''Biology''' is the [[science]] of life. Studies [[cell]]s, [[DNA]], [[evolution]], and [[ecology]].
The '''cell''' is the basic unit of life in [[biology]]. Contains [[DNA]] and [[protein]]s. Studied via [[microscope]].
'''DNA''' carries genetic information. Central to [[biology]], [[genetics]], and [[evolution]]. Found in [[cell]]s.
'''Evolution''' is the change in species over time. Core concept in [[biology]]. Driven by [[natural selection]] and [[DNA]] mutation.
'''Ecology''' studies organisms and their environments. Part of [[biology]]. Related to [[evolution]] and [[Earth]].
'''Genetics''' is the study of [[DNA]] and heredity. A branch of [[biology]]. Related to [[evolution]].
'''Earth''' is the third planet. Studied in [[geography]] and [[science]]. Has [[ocean]]s and [[continent]]s. Home to [[biology]].
'''Geography''' studies [[Earth]]'s landscapes. Related to [[history]] and [[science]]. Includes [[ocean]]s and [[continent]]s.
'''History''' is the study of past events. Related to [[geography]], [[science]], and [[Albert Einstein]].
An '''ocean''' is a large body of water on [[Earth]]. Studied in [[geography]] and [[ecology]].
'''Albert Einstein''' developed [[general relativity]] and contributed to [[quantum mechanics]]. A figure in [[history]] and [[physics]].
'''Chemistry''' is the [[science]] of [[matter]] and [[atom]]s. Related to [[physics]] and [[biology]]. Studies [[protein]]s.
'''Science''' is the systematic study of the world. Branches include [[physics]], [[chemistry]], [[biology]], and [[mathematics]].
'''Mathematics''' is the study of numbers and structures. Used in [[physics]], [[quantum mechanics]], and [[science]].
